s.note: Harold's life run to the second
s.how: Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread and fill 4 sandwiches with 150g ham and 150g grated cheddar. Cook in a pan over medium heat for exactly 3 minutes a side and cut into neat triangles.

s.note: Harold turning up at Ana's bakery with a box of flours
s.how: Brown 150g butter until nutty and cool 10 minutes. Whisk with 100g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 100g plain flour, 60g spelt flour, 40g rye flour, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Chill 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 180C. Roll into 16 balls, roll in demerara sugar and bake 11 to 12 minutes. Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm.

m.note: a night in after another audit
m.how: Cook 800g diced chicken thigh with 2 sliced leeks in 30g butter. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, 300ml chicken stock and 100ml cream and simmer 10 minutes. Spoon into a dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.n: Ana's warm skillet cookie with ice cream
w.note: the warm cookies Ana bakes for Harold, little did he know
w.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Beat 125g soft butter with 100g brown sugar and 50g caster sugar, then 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 180g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb, a pinch of salt and 150g chopped dark chocolate. Press into a buttered 23cm ovenproof frying pan and bake 18 to 20 minutes until golden at the edges but soft in the middle. Rest 5 minutes, top with 4 scoops of vanilla ice cream and drizzle with hot fudge sauce.

d.note: a cold glass of milk to go with Ana's cookies
d.how: Put 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Scrape the seeds from half a vanilla bean into a jug. Add 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 1 tbsp honey and 100ml milk and whisk into a smooth paste. Add 900ml very cold full cream milk and whisk hard, or blend for 20 seconds, until frothy. Pour into the frosted glasses and dust with a little more malt.
